typography.font_display: Impact, Haettenschweiler, 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Franklin Gothic Bold', sans-serif

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using black/10 or black/20 for crisp separation
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard brutalist shadow: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#221814] for filter card, subtle shadow-sm for feed cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md on header, backdrop-blur on image badges

motion.animations: d1-up (slide up with fade), d1-wipe (clip-path reveal), d1-mq-anim (continuous marquee), d1-drift-anim

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #221814 text on #FAF6F0 background. Meet minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable animations with media query prefers-reduced-motion

media.icons: Custom SVG or raw SVG paths for simplicity

instructions_to_main_agent: /app/design/direction.html is the visual source of truth. These guidelines transcribe it and add real images. On any conflict, the direction file wins. Ensure that the main agent implements it using tailwind css exactly as laid out in the direction file.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
